notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That page does not exist in the console.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use your {{server}} account.
signIn.noMethods: This server offers no sign-in method right now. Check the media server connector.

plex.waiting: Waiting for your approval on plex.tv…
plex.popupHint: A plex.tv window should have opened. If it did not, use the link below.
plex.badUrl: The server returned an unexpected Plex address. Nothing was opened.

quickConnect.hint: Enter this code in a Jellyfin app where you are already signed in.
quickConnect.waiting: Waiting for the code to be approved…

claim.title: Enter the setup code
claim.help: The code is in the server's data directory, in the file the startup log points to (for example /data/setup-code).
claim.label: Setup code

mediaServer.title: Connect your media server
mediaServer.help: Tindarr signs users in through this server and reads what they have watched.
mediaServer.lockedAll: The media server is set by environment variables on this server, so this step is skipped.
mediaServer.lockedField: Set by an environment variable: the value must match.

health.unreachable: The server could not be reached

plex.help: Approve on plex.tv with the account that owns this Plex server.
plex.tokenNotice: Tindarr keeps your plex.tv account token, not a token limited to this server: it is the only way to read each user's progress and to know who may use the server. It is encrypted, it is used only for the library, the watch state and the user list, and Tindarr never manages your Plex account.

signIn.title: Sign in as an administrator
signIn.help: Use an account that is an administrator on the media server. That sign-in finishes the setup.

publicUrl.title: Public address
publicUrl.help: The address phones use to reach this server. It is checked before it is saved, and it is what pairing QR codes point to.
publicUrl.label: Public address
publicUrl.checking: Asking that address whether it reaches this server…

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.intro: The services Tindarr talks to. Each one is tested before it is saved, and a key is never sent to an address it was not stored for.
connectors.verifyTlsHint: Turning this off also means sending the API key again.

secret.set: A key is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it.
secret.setEnding: A key ending in {{last4}} is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it.

health.unexpected_response: Something answered, but not as expected.
health.unsupported_version: That address answers as another product, or as a version Tindarr does not support.
health.unknown: Configured. Press “Test the connection” to check it.

mediaServer.title: Media server
mediaServer.help: Changed in the setup wizard: repointing it decides who can sign in, so it needs an administrator of the media server who has just re-authenticated.

tmdb.title: TMDb
tmdb.help: Where every suggestion is matched, and where posters, genres and streaming providers come from. Required for the swipe deck.

omdb.title: OMDb
omdb.help: Optional: adds the IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings to a card. Without it the cards simply have no such badges.

requests.title: Requests (Seerr)
requests.help: Seerr, Jellyseerr or Overseerr. A liked title is requested as the person who liked it, with their own permissions and quotas.
requests.urlHint: The address of the service itself, without /api.
requests.seasonsHint: What a request asks for when somebody likes a series.

llm.title: AI provider
llm.help: Picks the titles. Nothing it writes is used as anything but text: titles are looked up on TMDb, and the rest is displayed as it is.
llm.modelHint: Type a model id, or load the provider's list below.
llm.pickModelHint: Picking one fills the field above.
llm.reasoningEffortHint: Only some models accept it; it is dropped when the provider refuses it.

settings.title: Server settings
settings.name: Server name
settings.publicUrlHint: Origin the phones reach this server at, used in pairing QR codes. It is checked before it is saved.
settings.publicUrlChecking: Asking that address whether it reaches this server…
settings.later: Stored now, used in a later version
settings.mediaServerAdminOnly: Only an administrator of the media server can change this.

pairing.title: Connect a phone
pairing.help: Scan this code with the Tindarr app. The code works once and expires in a few minutes.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to pair a phone with {{host}}

status.pending: Waiting for a phone to scan the code…
status.awaiting_approval: A phone is asking to connect

pairing.confirmationCode: Approve only if your phone shows {{code}}

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.help: Every device signed in with your account.
sessions.revokeCurrentWarning: This is the browser you are using: you will be signed out.

deleteData.title: Delete my data
deleteData.help: Deletes your votes, taste profile, preferences and sessions on this Tindarr server. Nothing is deleted on the media server.
deleteData.understand: I understand this cannot be undone.
deleteData.confirm: Delete every trace of your account on this server?

reauth.title: Confirm it is you
reauth.help: This change needs a fresh sign-in on the media server.
reauth.noMethods: No way to confirm is available right now.

imports.title: Import what you have watched
imports.help: A Netflix, IMDb or Letterboxd export tells Tindarr what you already know about — and, more usefully, which series you finished and which you gave up on. It is a taste signal, never a vote.
imports.forgetConfirm: Everything this file told us is deleted. Your other imports and your calibration answers stay.

upload.title: Upload an export
upload.help: Netflix: "Viewing activity" → "Download all". IMDb: your ratings page → "Export". Letterboxd: settings → "Import & export" → the ZIP. The format is detected; you do not have to say which it is.
upload.started: Uploaded. Identifying the titles takes a moment.
upload.privacy: The file is read and thrown away: only the titles we could identify are kept, and the file name is never sent.

failure.metadata_unreachable: TMDb stopped answering, so the rest of the file was left alone. Try again later.
failure.interrupted: The server restarted while this was running. Upload the file again.
failure.internal_error: Something went wrong. Upload the file again.

skipped.not_a_title: {{count}} row that is not a film or a series dropped
skipped.not_a_title_other: {{count}} rows that are not films or series dropped
skipped.rows_over_limit: {{count}} row past the file size limit dropped
skipped.rows_over_limit_other: {{count}} rows past the file size limit dropped

review.help: These rows did not clearly name one title, so nothing was written down. Pick the right one, or say none of them is.
review.nothingFound: TMDb knew nothing like this row.

calibration.title: Films and series you already know
calibration.help: Tick the ones you have already watched. A few minutes here tells Tindarr more than any import can: it is what stops the deck offering you what you saw fifteen years ago. Nothing here counts as a vote.
calibration.empty: No poster to show. Check that TMDb is configured.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.intro: What the AI provider has been asked for, per user and per UTC day. A failure is a batch that was paid for and produced nothing.
usage.empty: No batch has been generated in this period.
